title: 9-Day Thailand Dual-Destination: Bangkok Glamour & Hua Hin Royal Links
description: The ultimate dual-city golf escape. Play Thai Country Club and Alpine in Bangkok, then Black Mountain and Pineapple Valley in Hua Hin.

signatureTour.title: The Bangkok & Hua Hin Fairways
signatureTour.highlight: Our flagship signature tour combining Bangkok’s finest private clubs with Hua Hin’s royal links and luxury pool villas.

inclusions.detail: All private luxury ground transport between Bangkok, golf courses, and Hua Hin.
4 championship rounds: Thai Country Club, Alpine Golf Club, Black Mountain, and Pineapple Valley.
4 nights at Sindhorn Kempinski Bangkok + 4 nights at V Villas Hua Hin.
Personal caddie and shared cart included for all rounds.
Continuous on-ground coordination and luggage transfer.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok & Sindhorn Kempinski Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Capital Arrival
itinerary.imageCaption: Sindhorn Kempinski Bangkok — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Sindhorn Kempinski Bangkok luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Bangkok and transfer via private luxury vehicle to Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok in the leafy Langsuan district.

Sip welcome cocktails in the lounge before enjoying an introductory dinner exploring contemporary Thai cuisine.

itinerary.title: Championship Prestige at Thai Country Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Private Club Test
itinerary.imageCaption: Thai Country Club — Denis Griffiths (Par 72, 7,097 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Thai Country Club championship golf course Denis Griffiths Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Thai Country Club, playing the championship layout won by Tiger Woods. Flawless conditioning and classic parkland bunkering test your game.

Return to Bangkok for an evening exploring the city's world-class dining and skyline cocktail bars.

itinerary.title: Tournament Test at Alpine Golf Club Bangkok
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Ronald Fream Design
itinerary.imageCaption: Alpine Golf & Sports Club — Ronald M. Garl (Par 72, 7,007 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Alpine Golf & Sports Club championship golf course Ronald M. Garl Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tackle the rolling fairways and water carries of Alpine Golf Club, one of the most demanding championship venues in Thailand.

Conclude your Bangkok stay with a private dinner at a Michelin-starred riverside restaurant.

itinerary.title: Executive Transit to Hua Hin & V Villas Pool Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Coastal Transition
itinerary.imageCaption: V Villas Hua Hin — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: V Villas Hua Hin luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Travel south via private executive coach along the Gulf coast to V Villas Hua Hin. Check into your private pool villa and unwind.

Spend the afternoon in your plunge pool before a relaxed seafood dinner on the beachfront.

itinerary.title: European Tour Majesty at Black Mountain Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Mountain Valley Test
itinerary.imageCaption: Black Mountain Golf Club — Phil Ryan (Par 72, 7,375 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Black Mountain Golf Club championship golf course Phil Ryan Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Black Mountain Golf Club, navigating dramatic granite bluffs, firm fairways, and rapid, undulating greens.

Return to V Villas for an afternoon swim, followed by an evening in Hua Hin town.

itinerary.title: Royal Beach Day of Rest & Pool Villa Relaxation
itinerary.subtitle: Rest & Restoration
itinerary.imageCaption: V Villas Hua Hin — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: V Villas Hua Hin luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
A dedicated rest day midway through the tour. Enjoy spa treatments, beach walks, or poolside relaxation.

Gather for a private sunset cocktail hour arranged by your personal villa host.

itinerary.title: Schmidt-Curley Masterpiece at Pineapple Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Round 4: Championship Finale
itinerary.imageCaption: Pineapple Valley Golf Club — Pirapon Namatra / Golf East (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Pineapple Valley Golf Club championship golf course Pirapon Namatra / Golf East Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Conclude your golf rotation at Pineapple Valley Golf Club, enjoying rolling fairways and panoramic mountain views.

Celebrate the completion of the 72-hole tour with sunset drinks at Mulligans Pub.

itinerary.title: Private Pool Villa Feast & Final Evening
itinerary.subtitle: Celebratory Farewell
itinerary.imageCaption: V Villas Hua Hin — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: V Villas Hua Hin luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy an unhurried morning with floating breakfast in your villa pool.

Gather for a private barbecue banquet prepared beside your pool, toasting an unforgettable 9-day dual-city tour.

itinerary.title: VIP Chauffeur Return to Bangkok Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: V Villas Hua Hin — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: V Villas Hua Hin luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast before packing your equipment with your villa host’s assistance.

Your private executive coach returns your party to Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport for your flight home.

faqs.question: How is the transit handled between Bangkok and Hua Hin?
faqs.answer: We provide private executive transport equipped with Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and luggage staging for a comfortable 2.5-hour journey.
